# Lodges
A lodge is an enclosed, secluded area that Yautja set up and operate from.
## Lodge placement and foundation - To declare a lodge, the Yautja must agree on a single site and secure the enclosed area, with every entrance and exit being a handcrafted sandstone door. - No more than one lodge can exist at a time. Should a lodge be destroyed, or the Yautja decide to abandon or move it, they must tear down its sandstone doors to the best of their ability before declaring a new site. - Lodges must be away from the main areas of the map, to keep them away from possible frontlines, and should not excessively affect any faction's ability to flank or maneuver. It is the Yautja's responsibility to make sure the lodge is in a secluded area. - Lodges must be made after the marines land, to avoid round impact.
## Lodge storage Gear that can be tracked should not be stored in the lodge, unless that gear is in the process of being recovered.
## Lodge defense Parties trespassing into the lodge that you were already engaged with, or that are taking a passive look around, are [color=#57b339]worthy[/color]. - Example of a passive look around: entering the lodge without engaging the Yautja, trying to roleplay.
Parties that attack the lodge itself, or enter it offensively, are [color=#ff0000]dishonorable[/color] for interfering with your hunt and attacking without due cause. - Example of an offensive entry: entering with weapons drawn and engaging the Yautja before the Yautja engages them. - Stray weapon fire or spit is not considered a deliberate attack. - Any vehicle that deliberately attacks the lodge may be dispatched by dishonorable means.
Multiple Yautja may attack the same prey that enters the lodge, but should be very careful with how they classify that prey to avoid problems.
